title: MessageProvenancePolicy v1 — the message provenance law as data: every fabric message must be signed by its node (signing_required is always true), unsigned traffic is never admitted (unsigned_allowed is always false), wrongly-signed traffic is never admitted (wrongly_signed_allowed is always false), and a replayed or out-of-sequence message is never admitted twice (replay_allowed is always false); signatures are Ed25519 (Y-011) over the SHA-256 fabric message digest (Y-050) — a policy naming any weaker law fails validation (Y-059)
